name: Senoo Miki
source:
Akira’s sister, has a personality that on the ulterior seems shallow and judges men for their looks. However, cares for Shiori alot and considered to be close friends. Miki is bold and knows the otaku subculture well, doesn’t hesitate to use her “moe” to seduce Ryou.

[From [url=http://whatistomato.wordpress.com/2010/06/10/riaimo-mini-review/]Tomato Conspiracy[/url]]
